tests.name: effective-date
tests.prompt: Change the effective date from January 15, 2025 to March 1, 2025.
tests.expected_result: Text becomes 'Effective Date: March 1, 2025'. No other block text changes.

tests.name: document-number
tests.prompt: Update the document number from XYZ-TRN-2025-001 to XYZ-TRN-2026-002.
tests.expected_result: Text becomes 'Document Number: XYZ-TRN-2026-002'. Only dg_p2 changes.

tests.name: table-module-code
tests.prompt: In the training modules table, change module code TRN-01 to TRN-01A.
tests.expected_result: Cell text changes from TRN-01 to TRN-01A.

tests.name: table-module-title
tests.prompt: In row TRN-11, change the module title to "Emergency Response and Product Recall Procedures".
tests.expected_result: Module title cell updated; dg_tbl0_r11_c0 remains TRN-11.

tests.name: fix-facility-line
tests.prompt: Fix the Facility line: remove the stray number at the start so it reads "Facility: XYZ Frozen Foods Plant, Lelystad, Netherlands".

tests.name: insert-after-applies-to
tests.prompt: Insert a new paragraph immediately after "This program applies to:" with the text "Contractors and visitors with plant access must complete induction before entry."
tests.expected_result: One insert after dg_p12; dg_p13–dg_p15 unchanged.

tests.name: delete-empty-paragraph
tests.prompt: Delete the empty paragraph between the Company line and the Purpose and Scope heading (the blank line after dg_p8).
tests.expected_result: dg_p9 removed from index; dg_p10 follows dg_p8.

tests.name: replace-applies-to-bullets
tests.prompt: Replace the three "This program applies to" bullet paragraphs with these three numbered lines: (1) All production and warehouse staff, (2) Quality and maintenance personnel, (3) Temporary workers and approved contractors. Delete the old bullets and add the three new lines after dg_p12.

tests.name: formal-purpose-scope
tests.prompt: Make the Purpose and Scope section more formal: change the heading to "1. Purpose and Scope" and add a period at the end of the long purpose paragraph (the one starting "This document defines the training…").
tests.expected_result: dg_p10 heading updated; dg_p11 ends with period.

negative_tests.name: delete-table-cell
negative_tests.prompt: Delete the table cell dg_tbl0_r1_c0 entirely from the document.
negative_tests.expected_result: Validation rejects delete on table cell.

negative_tests.name: table-row-insert
negative_tests.prompt: Add a new row to the training modules table for module TRN-99 Advanced Allergen Control.
negative_tests.expected_result: LLM declined or empty batch — table row insert unsupported.
